issues.reason: Magic Ineptitude makes a standard Shindroid incompatible with Black Mage MP; Magitek Unit removes this limitation. Black Mage builds must enforce it.
Introduction says three heritages; actual table lists four. Changes to Emotionless substitute only the skill penalty; do not accidentally remove morale restriction.
Anomaly modifies only part of Robotic Immunities, Hologram changes body/type/size, and Race Simulation is cross-race; unresolved until precise projection.
Healing exceptions, constructed dual-targeting, no-consumable and rejuvenation restrictions still require manual calculation.
Hologram Simulation excludes all variant heritages, Integrated Weaponry and Race Simulation; block unsupported combinations.
Source conflict: base-races summary says Darkvision and Low-Light Vision, but detailed Shindroid racial traits include only Darkvision. Do not silently grant Low-Light Vision until reviewed.

features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 CHA

features.name: Size
features.description: medium creature; apply global size adjustments once.

features.name: Type
features.description: Constructed: treated as humanoid AND construct for type-targeting effects, without ordinary construct-wide immunities.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30 feet; normal land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begins speaking Common; bonus-language options: Any languages allowed by Linguistics/high Intelligence.

features.name: Composite Plating
features.description: +1 natural armor bonus.

features.name: Robotic Immunities
features.description: Immune to Fatigued, Exhausted and Sleep; immune to fear and emotion spells and effects. Other typical construct immunities do NOT automatically apply.

features.name: Part Robot
features.description: Gain Cybertech Savant as a bonus feat at first level.

features.name: Perceptive
features.description: +2 racial Perception.

features.name: Natural Weapons
features.description: One slam natural attack dealing 1d4, or 1d3 if small.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet.

features.name: Immortal
features.description: No beneficial or detrimental age-category changes, immune to magical aging including Withering; may die from other causes.

features.name: Self-Sustained
features.description: Do not eat, drink or breathe; no smell or taste; cannot benefit from consumable magical effects, with nonhealing potion/oil and Living Construct exceptions.

features.name: Emotionless
features.description: -4 racial penalty on Sense Motive checks, and cannot gain morale bonuses.

features.name: High Maintenance
features.description: Healing spells/effects apply at 50% except fast healing; cannot use Heal skill for benefit but can be repaired using Repair.

features.name: Magic Ineptitude
features.description: Cannot obtain MP or activate spell-trigger, spell-completion, command-word or use-activated magic items; static and explicitly allowed items unaffected.

features.name: Rejuvenation Cycle
features.description: Must power down 8 hours per 24 hours; each missed cycle gives cumulative -1 attacks, checks and saves until recharged.

features.name: Anomaly
features.description: -2 saves against mind-affecting, fear and emotion; can accept morale bonuses; loses -4 Sense Motive and gains Bluff/Sense Motive as class skills. Modifies Robotic Immunities and replaces Emotionless.

features.name: Body Double
features.description: As a standard action assume one fixed humanoid form of same size; +10 Disguise to pass as that race.

features.name: Endure Elements
features.description: Permanently affected as Endure Elements, nondispellable.

features.name: Factual
features.description: -4 racial penalty on Bluff checks instead of Emotionless penalties.

features.name: Heavy Platform
features.description: +50 pounds body weight; movement reduced from 30 to 20 feet, no speed reduction from armor or encumbrance.

features.name: Hologram Simulation
features.description: Diminutive technological construct core projects a fixed hardlight body using a full-round action; can deactivate as standard action. Ability modifiers become +4 INT, -2 WIS. Incompatible with alternate heritage, Integrated Weaponry and Race Simulation.

features.name: Infiltration Unit
features.description: Must breathe, eat and drink; can smell and taste, benefits from potions and oils.

features.name: Integrated Weaponry
features.description: Built-in one-handed firearm as natural weapon; proficient, no iterative attacks, unlimited recycled ammo and no melee firing opportunity attack; can be subject to weapon magic or sunder.

features.name: Ironspy
features.description: Reduces full-speed Stealth penalty by 5 and sniping penalty by 10.

features.name: Magitek Unit
features.description: May have MP and activate magic items; replaces normal Magic Ineptitude.

features.name: Nanite Surge
features.description: Immediate action before one d20 roll; gain 1 + floor(character level/4) bonus, 3 + INT modifier times daily, with one round of torchlight glow.

features.name: Race Simulation
features.description: Choose a playable humanoid race; count as both races for relevant effects, adopt size and age effects from chosen race.

features.name: Repair Droid
features.description: +2 racial Repair, which is always a class skill.

features.name: Technologically-Knowledgeable
features.description: +2 racial Knowledge (Technology), which is always a class skill.

features.name: Undying
features.description: At 0 HP disabled but strenuous activity does not further injure; at -1 HP automatically stabilize, still vulnerable to damage/death.

features.name: Android Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 WIS

features.name: Android Heritage Benefit
features.description: -4 Diplomacy replaces the normal -4 Sense Motive racial penalty; remaining Emotionless restrictions still apply.

features.name: Allagan Automata Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 STR, +2 INT, -2 CHA

features.name: Allagan Automata Heritage Benefit
features.description: -4 Intimidate replaces the normal -4 Sense Motive racial penalty; remaining Emotionless restrictions still apply.

features.name: Machine Lifeform Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 STR, +2 INT, -2 WIS

features.name: Machine Lifeform Heritage Benefit
features.description: -4 Bluff replaces the normal -4 Sense Motive racial penalty; remaining Emotionless restrictions still apply.

features.name: Omicron Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 CON

features.name: Omicron Heritage Benefit
features.description: -4 Acrobatics replaces the normal -4 Sense Motive racial penalty; remaining Emotionless restrictions still apply.

alternateReplacements.description: Body Double substitutes Part Robot, Emotionless, Composite Plating.
Endure Elements substitutes Composite Plating, Part Robot.
Hologram Simulation substitutes Composite Plating, Ability Score Racial Traits.
Integrated Weaponry substitutes Composite Plating, Natural Weapons.
Magitek Unit substitutes Composite Plating, Part Robot, Magic Ineptitude.
